notes: לְבִלְתִּי: the ASV writes no negation word, the negation being carried inside 'cease', so בִלְתִּי is unrepresented and rule 30's one-word condition is unmet for a fusion with the preposition.
First vocative בְּנֵי takes the supplied 'ye' (rule 36); the coordinated second one takes only what is written.
